text: At its meeting held on February 21, 2018 North York Community Council adopted without amendment Item NY28.25 entitled "Parking Prohibitions - Farmview Crescent, Ringwood Crescent, George Henry Boulevard and Parfield Drive" and, in so doing, approved parking prohibitions to be in effect from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. on all or portions of Farmview Crescent, Ringwood Crescent, George Henry Boulevard and Parfield Drive. However, it was subsequently noticed that these parking prohibitions were intended to be in effect from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday. In order to correct this oversight, Item NY28.25 must be reopened and Recommendation 1 amended to reflect the correct times and days of these parking prohibitions. Transportation Services staff have been consulted regarding the above and have no concerns with the requested amendment. I respectfully request that this matter be added…

North York Community Council: 1. Amended Part 1 of the decision on Item NY28.25, by inserting the words, "Monday to "Friday" immediately after the reference to the times "6:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., so that Part 1 of the Decision is now the following: "1. Prohibit parking from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., Monday to Friday, on both sides of Farmview Crescent, between Parfield Drive and George Henry Boulevard; on both sides of Ringwood Crescent, between the west and east intersections with George Henry Boulevard; on the north side of George Henry Boulevard, between Silkwood Crescent and Don Mills Road; on both sides of Parfield Drive, between Meadowglade Crescent and George Henry Boulevard."
